record.question: Which one of the following is known as 'Sick Man of Europe'?
record.explanation: Answer C: Turkey. Turkey is the printed choice corresponding to the historical Sick Man of Europe epithet applied to the declining Ottoman Empire. Contemporary nineteenth-century historical writing explicitly labels Ottoman Turkey that way. Historical/source note: Historical Ottoman Empire epithet; not a current economic or political judgment about the Republic of Türkiye. Reference: https://www.gutenberg.org/files/45733/old/45733-h/45733-h.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
